subject: Linguistics
title: Independent Inventions
description: A micro-lesson that makes Independent Inventions usable.

hook.text: Writing was invented independently at least three times—in Mesopotamia, China, and Mesoamerica.

buildup.text: Each invention arose when complex societies needed to track taxes, rituals, or calendars.

discovery.text: Chinese oracle bone script appeared around 1200 BCE; Mayan glyphs emerged around 300 BCE.

twist.text: Some scholars argue Egyptian writing may also be independent—not borrowed from Sumerian.

climax.text: Wherever states and trade grew complex enough, writing emerged—independently and inevitably.

punchline.text: Complex societies don't just invent writing—they need it.

quiz.question: How many times was writing independently invented?
